app_fee.value: Research degree applications are not charged the AUD 150 application fee that applies to coursework applications.
app_fee.quote: Application fees will not be charged for research degrees

also.quote: A non-refundable application fee of AUD $150

fee_waiver.value: International students with a major Graduate Research School scholarship get a tuition fee waiver for the standard candidature length (up to 4 years for a PhD). No other international waiver is stated.
fee_waiver.quote: international graduate researchers with any major scholarship administered by the Adelaide University Graduate Research School are entitled to a fee waiver for the standard duration of candidature

gre_general.value: No GRE requirement appears on the research application or English pages reviewed.

toefl_min.value: The official English table equates the IELTS 6.5 minimum to TOEFL iBT 79. No separate TOEFL minimum is published, and only TOEFL iBT is accepted.

also.quote: The University only accepts the TOEFL iBT for Australia

ielts_min.value: The PhD minimum is IELTS Academic 6.5 overall, with 6 as the listed minimum for reading, listening and writing. Some disciplines need 7.0, but none of them is STEM.

also.quote: Please note some disciplines require a higher overall score of 7.0 with a minimum of 6.5 for each band

english_waiver.value: India is not on the recognised-country list, so Indian applicants need an accepted English test. Case-by-case exceptions are allowed only in limited circumstances.
english_waiver.quote: Recognised countries: Antigua and Barbuda ... USA, and US Virgin Islands

also.quote: In limited circumstances, previous academic qualifications or practical application of your English skills in a professional environment

notes: Intakes are January and July (PhD page). Applications are open all year. Scholarship rounds: the Graduate Research Talent Scheme Round 1 closes 2 November 2026 but is limited to domestic applicants and internationals with an Australian or New Zealand qualification; Round 2 (mid-February to late March 2027) and Round 3 (mid-July to mid-August 2027) follow. No round date for India-qualified applicants is stated.
